title: DAY 15/90
CALCULUS
scenes.sub: Engineering Maths is back: calculus day
scenes.voice: Day fifteen of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge. Ninety four days to GATE, and today we switch to engineering mathematics: calculus.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is engineering mathematics. Our topic: calculus, which shows up in almost every GATE mechanical paper.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover limits and continuity, Rolle's and Lagrange's mean value theorems, maxima and minima, and definite, improper and multiple integrals.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. For limits minus a to a, check the function first. Odd function: the integral is zero. Even function: twice the integral from zero to a.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Download the free practice set with step by step solutions on Telegram now. Tonight's test is from seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 14 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day fourteen toppers! Sweta Rani Sahoo tops with twenty four out of thirty. Rahul Yadav takes rank two, and Pranshu Kumar Yadav takes rank three. Congratulations to all three!
